notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size.
description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, and putting the land card into your hand due to Abundance.
After all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2 until there are no land cards remaining in your library.
Activate Goblin Charbelcher by paying {3} and tapping it, causing you to reveal your entire library and deal damage equal to your deck size to any target.
You may also repeat step 5 during each of your following turns, as mana permits.
